superAdmin.title: Platform Overview
superAdmin.subtitle: Tenant distribution. Platform health metrics are not wired up yet.
superAdmin.emptyDescription: Organizations that sign up will be listed here.
superAdmin.createTenantIntro: Creates the workspace and its first Business Owner together. The owner signs in with the email and password you set here.
superAdmin.fieldUrlSlugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. This becomes the workspace's web address and cannot be changed later.
superAdmin.fieldOwnerEmailHelp: The Business Owner who will run this workspace.
superAdmin.fieldOwnerPasswordHelp: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit. Share it with the owner securely.
superAdmin.errSlugFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
superAdmin.errPasswordRules: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.
superAdmin.confirmSuspendMessage: Everyone at {{name}} will be signed out and blocked from signing in. Nothing is deleted — all their data is kept, and you can reactivate the workspace at any time.
superAdmin.confirmReactivateMessage: {{name}} will be able to sign in again immediately, with all their data as they left it.
superAdmin.peopleEmptyDescription: Try clearing the filters, or create an account.
superAdmin.createUserIntro: The account is active straight away — share the password with them securely. To let someone choose their own instead, send an invitation from inside their workspace.
superAdmin.fieldRoleHelp: Business Owners administer their workspace. Staff work inside it.
superAdmin.fieldUserPasswordHelp: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.
superAdmin.platformSettingsSubtitle: Platform-wide defaults for new workspaces, or apply changes directly to workspaces you choose.
superAdmin.scopeSubtitle: Pick a scope before editing the fields below — it decides what Save actually does.
superAdmin.scopePlatformHint: Sets the starting values for workspaces created from now on. Existing workspaces are never affected.
superAdmin.scopeTenantsHint: Applies immediately to the workspaces you choose below — the same as each one's own admin making the change.
superAdmin.applyingToPlatform: Applying to: Platform default (future workspaces only)
superAdmin.confirmPlatformMessage: This changes the starting values for workspaces created from now on. No existing workspace is affected.
superAdmin.confirmTenantsMessage_one: This immediately changes settings for 1 workspace:
superAdmin.confirmTenantsMessage_other: This immediately changes settings for {{count}} workspaces:
